description: This file defines the DeviceConnectionClient interface which provides methods to interact with Hono's Device Connection API, including setting and retrieving the last known gateway for a device.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClient
classes.description: An interface for a client that interacts with Hono's Device Connection API, scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last gateway that acted on behalf of a specific device, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last gateway that acted on behalf of a specific device, returning a Future with the gateway ID or failing if none is set.
